plan.cover_image_prompt: reception desk of a local medical clinic, appointment booking moment, realistic photo, warm indoor light, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: At the reception desk or on the phone with a clinic receptionist, the learner is trying to book a doctor's appointment because they have had a sore throat and fever for three days.
Learner: the learner is a patient. Partner: the partner is a receptionist.
Learner must be able to: say they want to make a doctor's appointment; briefly explain the reason for the visit; choose a convenient day and time; ask what documents or information are needed.
Partner will: offer available appointment times; ask for basic details and the reason for the visit; tell the learner what to bring or when to come.
Not in this scene: describing symptoms in detail, answering medical questions, diagnosis, treatment, prescription.
scenes.image_prompt: clinic reception desk with appointment calendar and computer, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: In the doctor's office during the appointment, the learner talks to the doctor about a sore throat and fever that have lasted for three days. This is the main interaction of the event.
Learner: the learner is a patient. Partner: the partner is a doctor.
Learner must be able to: say that their throat hurts; say they have a fever; explain how long the symptoms have lasted; answer simple questions about pain, temperature, and general condition.
Partner will: ask what is wrong and how long it has lasted; ask simple follow-up questions about symptoms; give a basic explanation and simple instructions.
Not in this scene: booking the appointment, choosing a time, asking about documents, paying, buying medicine.

topic.description_target: Nauczysz się umówić wizytę, podać powód, wybrać termin i zapytać o dokumenty.
topic.description_native: Вы научитесь записываться на приём, называть причину, выбирать время и спрашивать о документах.

check.explanation_native: Администратор спрашивает, почему пациент хочет записаться.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_native: У меня болит горло и температура.

check.explanation_native: Она спрашивает, с чем пациент обращается.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Mamy wolny termin jutro o dziesiątej.
messages.text_native: У нас есть свободное время завтра в десять.

check.explanation_native: Администратор предлагает запись на завтра на десять часов.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Да, у нас есть завтра в пятнадцать.

check.explanation_native: После вопроса пациента администратор предлагает время на 15:00.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Да, у нас есть завтра в пятнадцать.

check.explanation_native: Речь идёт о записи на завтра на 15:00.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: Proszę przynieść dokument i kartę ubezpieczenia.
messages.text_native: Пожалуйста, принесите документ и страховую карту.

check.explanation_native: Администратор просит принести документ и страховую карту.
Во второй раз она повторяет, что нужна страховая карта.

check.explanation_native: Администратор просит прийти за десять минут до назначенного времени.
